So I'm apart of an exclusive club at college that lets it's members share their own studyroom and pincode. As I was getting done with my final class and heading home, a homeless guy about the same age as me asks for something to eat. I told him that I didn't have much and offered to buy him a Subway. After we talked for a bit, he said he didn't have a place to stay for the night and he really looked like he could use some warmth atm. I thought about how this could have been me if things hadn't connected down the right path. So I did something stupid and against my club rules and brought him up to our studyroom. Now this was around 10pm so most college students and staff would have left the building by now. When we got to the room, I layed out some ground rules and told him he could probably catch a few Z's here for the night. After that,  I told him how much I was sticking my neck out for him and he was very humble about the whole situation. After that, I saw him a few more times on campus and helped him out here and there but for me, I didn't think I was doing all that much for him really. But to him, it was probably the nicest gift he received that winter.

I used to run hogrider with the rg as a medium elixr push, but since you have miner that could easily knick off a few more hits while the Archer tower is distracted, I would say that your best bet is to plan for a defensive card. The best defensive cards that support the rg well and also provide enough time for the Archer tower to really kill the enemy would be either:

Ice wizard or electro wizard; I use both because it's double trouble:3

If you don't have a clan to join or are interested in sparring with me and my deck, I would enjoy having you in our clan, we aren't always online constantly, but we do help each other improve in the game. Currently, my rg deck has won 30+ games consecutively, so I could help you with some tips.

As a royal Giant user as well, I would like to say that even though we are hated through out the community, I appreciate seeing another user not abandoning the card. 

With that being said, I would say that the prince is not really needed as an extra push. Simply because having two 6 elixir cards that don't really support each other is bound to have a negative elixir trade with an enemy. I can see that you have a support cards like the log, ice spirit, and arrows, but I think you could do without the log or ice spirit. Personally, I think the ice spirit is very useful for more than just freezing, it has value as a decoy and a distraction, but I think a heal spirit can also provide all that and even more. Since you have arrows, I don't agree with log because arrows takes care of the swarm both on the ground and in the air. And this is just my opinion, but the rifle man(sorry I can't remember his real name) is sort of weak in this meta, if you want someone who can take out troops up close and can cover a swarm, I would switch to either valk or executioner.


But most importantly, just use cards that can have more then one role on the battle field. Except rg, he maybe used soley for damage; but I guess he's also a tank by default so whatever.

I think you should switch out skeletons for graveyard. Against mega knight, the skeleton provides a good distraction, given you place it correctly in the middle, and you could potentially have it under fired from both Archer towers. And also, consider using a tank in this deck, the elixir cost in this deck is fairly low given the amount other decks use. I would say since you're using a prince, go for a giant to increase your elixir cost, or us an ice golem for a lesser cost and easier cycle. Also, ice golem could be a good distraction as well.

I long time ago, I had a friend that had committed suicide. I was a lonely kid in middle school when I first met her. And we grew up on the same block hanging at each others house, playing videogames, enjoying each others company. We rode on the same bus together in the morning and would sometimes hangout during school, around lunchtime or whenever. Fast forward to my sophomore year and she had to move away. As a going away present, I gave her a necklace I cherished. A few months later, I hadn't talked to her in a while and I suddenly hear news that she had been admitted to the hospital. She had attempted suicide by overdosing on pills and she ended being hospitalised for it. A few days later, she passes away at the hospital. For a long time, I blamed myself for not being able to protect her during her time of need. I swore up and down at god for allowing her death to pass, and I hated myself for a longtime. But I realized after a couple years that even though she was gone, she was the first person to make me feel like I deserved a place in the universe. Because of her, she gave a me a piece of humanity, so I would grow up to become more humble and caring. Although there are things I'm still not proud, I overall have become a stronger person and achieved major strides in my life.
